_comment: One guard on a provider endpoint (D-028): the server (agent::providers::base_url) and both dialogs (src/lib/agent/baseUrlGuard.ts) run every case. The first group is the web's test_agent_composer_backend.py TestTheProviderEndpointGuard. 'normalized' is what the server stores and requests; 'class' is what the host is. Metadata covers the service's names and the whole link-local blocks (169.254.0.0/16, fe80::/10, fd00:ec2::/32) after unwrapping IPv4-mapped, IPv4-compatible and NAT64 spellings, the rule the Agent's HTTP client connects by. The two kinds that take an endpoint (ollama, openai_compatible) may both reach loopback and private hosts, as on the web.
